record.title: Solar Water Heating Collectors - Domestic Thermal Systems, Current Requirements
record.description:
Specifies current thermal performance, pressure integrity, durability, materials, insulation, and marking requirements for domestic solar water-heating collectors used in building-scale hot-water systems.

Applies to current collector models intended for domestic or small institutional hot-water systems; the 2023 demo edition is superseded and retained only for historical traceability.

Key requirements: Declared thermal performance shall be supported by the current test method and reporting format.; Collector circuit shall withstand the specified pressure and leakage checks.; Insulation and absorber construction shall maintain performance after durability conditioning.; Materials and coatings shall be suitable for the declared operating temperature and environment.

Testing requirements: Thermal performance test using the current conditioning and reporting method.; Pressure integrity and leakage test.; Thermal cycling and stagnation-related durability checks where applicable.; Material, coating, and insulation inspection.

Documentation required: Current collector technical specification.; Hydraulic and installation diagrams.; Laboratory performance report.; Material/coating evidence and traceability record.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification.; Collector model/type.; Declared thermal-performance designation.; Current standard number and traceability mark.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable when a product-control or procurement route explicitly requires this current edition; otherwise test evidence may support voluntary conformity.
